scope: Repair F1–F5 from the full Luna interactive TUI audit; correct canonical tool inventory.
overall: All five repair acceptance criteria passed; full unrestricted live coverage is not claimed.

commits.fix: F3 shared builtin skill catalog and captured execution
F5 runtime stdio LSP, lifecycle and scoped diagnostics

local_executables.hya-ts: Built and exercised through the actual tmux TUI

verification.method: Reuse final successful gates for unchanged production source; index-only intermediate release staging did not change tested working-tree source.

live_results.image: Actual TUI PNG identified as Red; provider received input_image.
live_results.escape: Uninstrumented visible streaming interrupted with one physical Escape; finish=cancelled and backend idle.
live_results.skills: Both advertised tested builtin skills loaded successfully; long-body Generic output cap intentionally unchanged.

lsp.diagnostics: Real apply_patch introduced a TypeScript string-to-number error, then removed it after correction.

builtin_coverage.basis: 24 successful canonical tools in baseline audit plus real LSP acceptance here; this is cumulative coverage, not a fresh run of every tool on 0.36.18.
builtin_coverage.reason: Existing modern-GPT policy does not expose them to the only authorized live model; policy intentionally preserved.
builtin_coverage.supplement: Workspace and process tests cover these tools with deterministic providers; not counted as live Luna acceptance.

limits: Canonical write/edit cannot be exposed for Luna without changing the product or model restriction.
Real desktop clipboard/IDE notifications and production OAuth/update activation were not validated.
Existing automated fixtures supplement, not replace, interactive live verification; not all UI modifiers/media formats/mouse branches were independently exercised.
Live language-server acceptance used TypeScript; other discovered/configured language servers were not individually exercised.
Unversioned push diagnostics are bounded two-second best-effort collection, not a completion guarantee.
api_changes: SkillCatalogEntry constructors require an explicit origin.
LspProvider::diagnostics receives workdir and authorized targets; external implementations must migrate.
evidence_notes: Earlier final-* investigation captures are retained for context; use the per-fix evidence references for final acceptance. Private heap contents and credentials are excluded.
publication: Atomic local commits only; no push, release tag, production credential modification or update activation.
